current_activity: command post at Saint-Hilaire-du-Harcouët as the corps enters Third Army operations
notes: Event date: 6 August 1944 (CMH command-post list as compiled by World War II by Day: first entry; the 35th Division passed to XX Corps the same day per the CMH division table). Breakout-18 p344: the XX Corps headquarters arrived in France on 24 July; Breakout-22 p431: about 3 August Patton brought in XX Corps to hold the Mayenne south of Château-Gontier and guard the Loire flank. Event definition: first documented command post. Location: commune centroid. Relationship: Third Army assigned.
Wikipedia: XX Corps (Walker) took Angers on 10 August; Breakout-28 p559 shows the 5th Division joining XX Corps on 4 August for the drive.

current_activity: establishing the Marne bridgehead at Château-Thierry
notes: Wikipedia: XX Corps made the Marne bridgehead on 27 August; Breakout-28 p588 notes four Third Army bridgeheads across the upper Seine by 25 August.
Lorraine Campaign p4: Third Army crossed the Meuse at Verdun and Commercy on 31 August; Wikipedia assigns the Verdun crossing to XX Corps.

current_activity: closing on the Moselle at Metz and Thionville
notes: Wikipedia: XX Corps reached the Moselle at Metz and Thionville on 7 September; Lorraine-3 narrates the fighting for the Moselle bridgeheads. Objective check (Batch 2 review): the corps reached the river at the town on the row date, so documented_on_date holds.

current_activity: 5th Division bridgehead at Arnaville across the Moselle
notes: Lorraine-3 p147: the Arnaville bridgehead held against German counterattacks; no bridge was in place at daylight.

current_activity: crosses the Moselle north of Metz; the 5th Division follows on the 9th
notes: Event date: 9 November 1944 (Lorraine p388: the XX Corps advance started the day after the XII Corps offensive and the initial American crossing east of Uckange took place on the night of 8-9 November; p416: the 5th Division received its formal order to attack on 9 November; p375: the XX Corps troops lay quiet on 8 November while the XII Corps began). Event definition: XX Corps' envelopment of Metz opens with the Moselle crossings north of the city; the point is a sector centre at the Uckange crossing, not the corps headquarters. Relationship: Third Army assigned. Location: Uckange commune centroid chosen from the Green Book crossing named on the night of 8-9 November; the front of the corps is wider (the 90th Division at Koenigsmacker and the 95th and 5th Divisions at Metz). Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Uckange. Event support: high (Green Book narrative). Location support: moderate (documented crossing place but the corps front is wide).
